environment: Claude continues streaming paragraphs detailing the exact functions of train set (gradient updates), validation set (periodic evaluation and early stopping), and test set (final generalization evaluation), followed by the concept of overfitting inflection points.
text_visible: 这背后的逻辑是数据集的三重划分各有职责：
训练集（train set）用来做梯度更新。验证集（validation/eval set）在训练过程中定期评估模型表现，用于做 early stopping 和超参数选择等决策。测试集（test set）完全不参与训练过程的任何决策，只在最后用来报告模型的泛化性能。
Early stopping 的核心思路是：训练损失会持续下降，而验证损失一开始也会下降，但一旦过拟合开始，验证损失就会上升。Early stopping 的目标就是在验证损失最低的那个拐点停下来。
details: My gaze moves across the bullet points and explanations regarding train, validation, and test set separation.

action: I read the section explaining why test loss cannot be used for stopping decisions to prevent information leakage.
action_brief: I read the explanation of why test loss causes information leakage.
environment: Claude generates a dedicated explanation section explaining that selecting checkpoints based on test loss converts the test set into a second validation set, compromising unbiased evaluation through information leakage.
text_visible: 为什么不能用 test loss 来做停止决策？因为验证集的表现实际上间接影响了你对模型权重配置的选择（比如选哪个 checkpoint），所以验证集已经“参与”了训练过程。测试集的存在就是为了提供一个完全独立的、从未影响过任何训练决策的评估——只有这样才能给出对模型真实泛化能力的无偏估计。如果你根据 test loss 来决定什么时候停，那 test set 就变成了第二个 validation set，你就失去了对真实泛化性能的客观度量，本质上是一种信息泄漏。
details: My gaze rests directly on the explanation of information leakage and test set independence.

action: I read the LLM-specific considerations detailing why validation loss is not the sole metric due to refusal rates and format compliance.
action_brief: I read LLM fine-tuning considerations regarding loss and format compliance.
environment: Claude streams the section '但在 LLM 微调中，有一些重要的额外考量：', explaining that loss curves cannot capture qualitative criteria like refusal rates or format compliance.
text_visible: 但在 LLM 微调中，有一些重要的额外考量：
首先，loss 只是一个指标，不应该作为唯一的停止标准。一个 checkpoint 可能 loss 很好但拒答率很高，另一个 checkpoint loss 更高但格式遵从性更好。Loss 曲线不会告诉你哪个更好。
details: My gaze focuses on the discussion of checkpoint trade-offs between loss metrics and output format adherence.

action: I read the points discussing the mismatch between training loss and downstream out-of-domain task evaluation.
action_brief: I read the analysis on training loss versus downstream task evaluation.
environment: Claude finishes generating the final paragraph explaining in-domain training loss vs out-of-domain downstream evaluation and why perplexity does not strictly predict task success.
text_visible: 其次，训练损失和下游任务表现之间可能存在不匹配。训练损失主要反映 in-domain 的拟合程度，而下游任务通常是 out-of-domain 的评估。在相同的训练损失水平下，不同大小的模型在下游任务上的表现可能不同。
对于 LLM 微调来说，下游任务表现通常比训练损失或 perplexity 更好的指标，而且 perplexity 并不总是与实际的下游任务表现相关。
